carrier_denial_notice: CLAIM DENIED ($0 PAYOUT): Flight UA-418 arrived 4h 25m late due to Extraordinary Weather Conditions at Departure Hub (Code WX-88).
passenger_statement: It was a crystal-clear evening in San Francisco and planes at the gates on both sides of us pushed back on time. We sat at Gate G94 for over four hours and I paid $240 out of pocket for food and airport lodging. Why was I denied?
